packageRules.description: One PR per stack, so a merge is one Portainer redeploy. Majors still get their own PR.

Databases and caches follow the app, not their own releases. Digest refreshes keep the tag's own patches coming; a tag change is done by hand when the app's release notes call for it. A Postgres major also can't read the previous major's data directory, so that's a dump and restore, not a tag bump.
Immich migrations are one-way and it warns against skipping versions. Let a release settle first.
Sure runs one-way Rails migrations and releases often. Let a release settle first.
